title: Some effects may be architecture-dependent
description: The observation that symmetric operations require less data for generalization may be partially dependent on the transformer architecture, since transformers can easily learn symmetric functions by ignoring positional embeddings.
canonical_description: some observed effects may be partially dependent on transformer architecture

evidence.quote: We believe this effect might be partially architecture-dependent, since it's easy for a transformer to learn a symmetric function of the operands by ignoring positional embedding.
